title: 22 Lengths (KINO)
synopsis: Tilda's days leave no room to breathe: studying, working the supermarket checkout, and raising her little sister Ida, because their mother is lost to alcohol. Her only escape is swimming exactly 22 lengths at the local pool. When a PhD offer in Berlin and the unexpected arrival of Viktor hint at a life beyond duty, she dares to imagine a different future. But home has other plans. Adapted from Caroline Wahl's bestselling novel, 22 Bahnen is a tender portrait of sacrifice and sisterhood. Winner of the Gilde-Filmpreis for Best Film and the Frankfurt Book Fair Prize for Best Adaptation.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: Alles wird gut，就是一切都會好起來的意思。蒂達的生活營營役役充滿壓力，大學下課後，要到超級市場做兼職養家，更要照顧年幼妹妹，再「打大佬」面對終日酗酒情緒失控的媽媽。蒂達唯一的出口，就是在泳池游22個塘的時間。泳池就成了一個徹底讓她擺脫日常枷鎖，寧靜自在的療癒空間。獲得柏林大學博士學位取錄的她，偶然之下認識了對她心生好感的域多，在前途、愛情和家庭之間，她又可以如何抉擇？或者就像蒂達妹妹所說，alles wird gut，關關難過關關總會過。電影改編卡羅琳華爾暢銷小說，感動人心。

cast: Luna Wedler, Jannis Niewöhner, Laura Tonke
